title: Water supply timings change this week
body: Morning water supply will run 30 minutes earlier for the next week because of pipeline maintenance. Please store water the evening before.

title: Free health check-up camp
body: A free blood pressure and sugar check-up camp is planned at the community hall from 9 AM to 1 PM. Bring a photo ID.

title: Separate your wet and dry waste
body: Keep two bins at home: one for kitchen waste and one for dry waste like paper and plastic. It makes collection faster and recycling easier.

title: Ward sabha meeting open to all residents
body: Residents are invited to share suggestions about roads, parks and street lights at the ward meeting this month.

title: Report broken street lights with a photo
body: When you report a street light problem, add the pole number or a nearby landmark. A clear location helps the repair team find it quickly.

title: Neighbourhood tree plantation drive
body: Volunteers are invited to plant saplings in the local park on Saturday morning. Gloves and saplings will be provided.

title: Check your documents before applying for a scheme
body: Most schemes ask for Aadhaar, address proof and a bank account. Keep photocopies ready to avoid second visits to the office.

title: Road repair work on Majitha Road
body: Resurfacing work will take place on parts of the road over the next ten days. Expect slow traffic during the day and use alternate routes if possible.
